xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: 1.NRI repatriable and non-repatriable shareholding is clubbed together under the head NRI shareholding. 2. The bifurcation of the FPIs in Category I & II is done on the basis of details shared by the RTA. 3. Foreign ownership disclosed is total of FPI (category I & II), FII, NRI (repat + non-repat) & Foreign National category shareholding. 4.Note w.r.t Promoter and Promoter Group entities a. Pursuant to Section 2(pp) of the SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, the Company and its subsidiaries form part of the Promoter Group. However, on the account of section 19 of the Companies Act, 2013 which prohibits subsidiaries from holding shares in its holding company, they are excluded from the list of Promoter Group. b. MLL Global Logistics Limited , Sampo Rosenlew Oy, Finland, Mahindra Ideal Lanka (Private Limited), Mahindra Aerospace Australia Pty. Limited and Mahindra Summit Agriscience Limited were disclosed as part of promoter group as disclosed in the shareholding pattern filed for the previous quarter. They have ceased to be part of promoter group with effect from 10th June, 2025, 30th September 2025,14th August, 2025, 30th October, 2025 and 29th June 2026 respectively. c. Bristlecone India Limited's name was changed to Bristlecone India Private Limited pursuant to its conversion to a private company, Mahindra-BT Investment Company (Mauritius) Limited's name was changed to Mahindra Investment Company Mauritius Ltd and Mahindra Ideal Finance Limited's name was changed to Mahindra Ideal Finance PLC w.e.f 20th January 2026, 9th February 2026 and 30th April 2026 respectively.5.Further, there have been additions in the promoter group as compared to the details disclosed during the previous quarter. Foreign Entities falling under Promoter Group are shown under Table II A(2)(e).6.The category Bodies Corporate also includes shares held by the Company in Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited Suspense Escrow Account and MLDLRightsIssue2025 - Demat Suspense Account.
